faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) for filling up the Field Work Supervisor positions in Mumbai, Maharashtra under a contractual agreement.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post announced in this notification?
faq.answer: The advertised position is for a Field Work Supervisor (Part-Time) associated with the Post Graduate Diploma in Psychotherapy and Counselling with Children and Adolescents.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Field Work Supervisor position under this recruitment notification published by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Psychology along with a minimum of 3 years of practical experience working as a psychotherapist or counsellor with children and adolescents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Field Work Supervisor post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 38,000/- for their part-time contribution.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for this job?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email along with all required supporting documents and updated CV is 10 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via email. Interested candidates must send their detailed CV and application materials to the designated official email address.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this post?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for applying to the Field Work Supervisor recruitment at the Tata Institute of Social Sciences.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the candidates?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their educational qualifications and relevant experience, followed by a telephonic or online interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application be emailed?
faq.answer: Candidates should send their complete application and detailed CV to the official email address specified in the notification, ensuring the post name is clearly written in the subject line.
